title: Southern Company Energy Usage
description: Daily or interval energy consumption data for a Southern Company utility account, measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh) for electric service or therms for natural gas service.

accountNumber.description: The utility account number associated with this usage data.

usageDate.description: The date for which usage is reported (YYYY-MM-DD).

usageKwh.description: Energy consumption in kilowatt-hours for electric service.

usageTherms.description: Energy consumption in therms for natural gas service.

peakDemandKw.description: Peak demand in kilowatts recorded during the usage period.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated cost in US dollars for the recorded usage.

readType.description: Indicates whether the reading was actual (metered), estimated, or customer-reported.

intervalMinutes.description: The interval length in minutes for interval data (15-min, 30-min, hourly, or daily).

temperature.description: Average outdoor temperature in degrees Fahrenheit for the usage period.
